name: Mage-VL-Cowork
context_scaling: Native 262144 (config text_config.max_position_embeddings 262144; the text tower is Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507, inherited unchanged). Card does not publish a separate context-extension recipe.
attention_variant: Inherited Qwen3-4B text tower: 36 full_attention layers, 8 KV heads, head_dim 128 (GQA 4:1). All 36 layers hold a per-token KV cache - no hybrid/linear layers.
notes: KV BASIS (derived): 36 layers x 2 (K and V) x 8 KV heads x 128 head_dim x 2 bytes = 147456 bytes/token; vision-tower tokens are counted per image, not in this per-text-token figure. FLOPS BASIS (derived): 2 x params_b for a dense forward pass. ADDED 2026-11-04 from the trending sweep (trendingScore 145, image-text-to-text). PARAMS: safetensors.total 4741793792 = 4.742B, dense; the text tower is Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 (2560 hidden, 36 layers, 8 KV heads at head_dim 128) so the ViT and projector add ~0.2B over the 4.66B base LLM. IT IS A FINETUNE of microsoft/Mage-VL (not a catalog record), trained through five stages (GUI midtraining, GUI agent SFT, coding/terminal SFT, hybrid CUA SFT, online hybrid RL). Ingested as its own model record because its base is absent from the catalog and mk_finetune_record.py would refuse it. WHY IT EARNS A RECORD: 66.0% on OSWorld-Verified at 4.0B params, which the card reports as the best 4B result and above Qwen3.6-27B (63.9), Qwen3.5-27B (56.2), EvoCUA-32B (56.7) and OpenCUA-72B (44.9) in the same table. It is NOT the table's best row: ScaleCUA-Qwen3.5-9B posts 68.7 overall, and it wins that comparison only on the OS (87.5 vs 79.2) and multi-app workflow (62.7 vs 48.1) slices while losing Office (64.9 vs 70.6), Daily (65.0 vs 74.3) and Professional (66.3 vs 89.5). Human reference on the same 361 tasks is 72.4. CAVEATS: every number is Microsoft's own run on their own MAGEHybridAgent scaffold, so it is vendor_claim and scaffold-dependent - a different harness will not reproduce 66.0. The card's OSWorld-G / ScreenSpot-v2 figures (56.9 / 87.2) belong to the stage-2 GUI SFT checkpoint, not the final model, and are deliberately not recorded here. SIZING for a low-VRAM box: 4.74B x 0.5 GiB/B = 2.4 GiB at bf16. No GGUF as of this sweep.
